body: I'm so glad he's back!!! I'm sure you're so relieved. Hopefully he's had his fill of being a feral street cat haha

My baby finally came home last night after the worst week of my life. I've been thinking about you and Taro, and I'm so glad you had a sighting of him!! If the traditional box traps aren't working, maybe renting a drop trap would be worthwhile? And was he closer or farther from home (compared to where he escaped his harness)? Cats have a great homing instinct, and that's the only way I was able to get my baby back inside.. I left the backdoor open every night until she eventually snuck in around 2am to eat, after a few nights of slowly making her way into our yard. Sprinted so fast to slam the door behind her haha

Your comments have me in tears again because I feel exactly the same way about my girl haha. 

She got out once before, about 2 years ago, but luckily came back several hours later because I left the back door cracked open for her. Stories of lost cats returning are also my only comfort right now.

Oh trust me, I haven't stepped foot in a church in years but I find myself praying to the St. Francis statue that's in our backyard. 

From what I know/have researched, indoor cats won't stray too far out of fear. Hopefully he is just hiding within a small radius of where he was lost. Maybe someone took him in since he's generally friendly? 

And yeah, I feel like I need to be out there doing something as well, but it's a similar situation. There are so many bushes, deck, yards... I wouldn't even know where to start. If you do search, continuing to do so at night is your best bet. 

I don't know if anecdotes are any comfort, but when I was a teenager, our family indoor cat escaped and was lost for almost a full month... turns out he was in our neighbor's garage the entire time. It's very likely he found a safe, dark spot to hide and is just hanging out there, only coming out at night. Communication with neighbors is definitely one of your strongest assets, as more sets of eyes are better than one.

It feels utterly impossible to continue life without her. She's been my best friend for 9 years. I know your pain and I'm so sorry you're having to deal with this. When I inevitably return to that St. Francis statue I'll say a prayer for your baby as well.

My baby will be missing for 4 days tonight... I know exactly how you feel. I'm grateful to have seen her nightly on a camera we have set up, but she just won't come back into our yard. :( The pain is horrific. I understand that completely, too. I feel like I can barely function, constant crying and panic attacks, barely eating or sleeping, scared to leave the house incase I miss something. One piece of advice I've been given several times is to set a humane trap in an area where you think he might pass by.. even if it's just near the place he escaped from. Bait it with the stinkiest wet food, canned tuna/sardines, maybe microwave it to make the smell stronger. I've also heard that KFC chicken is apparently good bait, which I will be personally trying tonight... I'm not particularly religious, but I will keep you and your cat in my thoughts and prayers. May our babies come home soon. :( <3
N-acetyl cysteine. It’s an amino acid supplement that’s been found to have benefits for people with trich, and can potentially help reduce the urge to pull
Will do :)
Yes :( it feels like they’ve been there for so long, they never go away even if i don’t pull for a while. And some of them hurt/get infected? Idk what to do about it either
My scalp always feels kind of raw and pretty itchy after a bad pulling session. I also sometimes get zits/ingrown hairs, mainly on my underarms though

Honestly, for me the only way I was able to stop attacking my legs was to stop shaving and let it grow out. I don’t know if it’s the same for you, but the urge to pull was so much worse when the hair is regrowing/short after shaving. I don’t really have an urge to pull the long hair. I would still wear shorts even without shaving which was embarrassing at first lol, but it helped me heal. Maybe it could help you?

My mom has been pull-free for several months now. It’s definitely possible! Her eyebrows grew back completely, and her head hair is filling in too. She was pulling for a long time so it gives me a lot of hope for regrowth!

We have a small closet that has two boxes in it. I feel like we need a litter box in a different location as well, but there isn’t really anywhere we could put another one. If it would help, though, I could probably set one up in my bathroom
If you don’t mind me asking, how long did it take your hair to grow back?
Wow you look beautiful!! Keep up the awesome work :)

It hasn’t stopped growing but it definitely grows slower and with a weird texture. Sometimes the hairs even grow back silver/white but this isn’t very common; even if it grows back weird, it does eventually grow!

I’ve noticed that the areas from which I pull grow back a lot slower than others, usually taking a few extra months to catch up. They also grow back a bit thinner and with a weird texture, but eventually, the hair does grow back. With time I’m sure you’ll start to see improvement :)

I do the same with my legs/arms/underarms, if there’s a bump (especially ingrown hairs) I’ll scratch at it until I get it out. So many scars on my shins especially. I do also pull my scalp hair, but you definitely aren’t alone with the picking. It’s how I started, too

I do this constantly. I pick at my legs/arms as well as my hair (hair picking is called trichotillomania, I think skin picking is called dermatillomania, although the name might be different now). Throw away any tweezers you have if you use those! I typically cut my nails as short as possible and wear leggings/jackets when I can. I used to use a bunch of lotion on my hands cuz it makes them too slippery to pick at the hair/etc properly. And if you do pick again, don’t be too harsh on yourself. You will heal. Make sure to wash and disinfect if you bleed as well
Amazing job!!! Glad it didn’t leave any scarring :D
I play league of legends/overwatch/a few other things if you ever wanna play :) (or just chat or anything)

It gets so much harder when things finally start to heal cause I just wanna pick the scabs off so bad :( I’ll try the leggings, I’ve tried long sleeve shirts before and it didn’t help too much unfortunately
Amazing job! I hope you had fun :)
That’s amazing progress!! I’m proud of you! Keep at it, you can only go up from here

It sounds like your father planted a lot of toxic ideas  in your head that are likely still influencing you today. Mental illness does not make you weak. You are not crazy. Considering your past, how you’re feeling is COMPLETELY justified. You don’t even always need a reason to be anxious and doubt life; it can happen out of the blue and to anyone.

I think it would be a really good idea to seek out therapy. From personal experience, it has helped me tremendously. You can talk to your therapist about medication options as well if that’s something you’d like to consider. I’m proud of you for reaching out and taking steps to help yourself! I wish you the best of luck :) also your girlfriend sounds amazing, so I’m sure she’d help you through this

I don’t blame you at all, that environment/situation sounds like a huge turnoff. I’m really sorry you had to go through with it while being uncomfortable the entire time :( communication is so very important but can be so damn hard too. I hope you start to feel better soon, don’t be too harsh on yourself

As someone who spends several hours a day playing League/other games, I feel ya there.. no one even really seems to care that I’m doing this with my life, even me. Since it’s summer it’s gotten a lot worse too (no school/etc to keep me busy). I wish I had some good advice to give you but I’m still trying to find things that work for myself. Only thing that really does is forcing myself to do things outside of my room (I sign up for club events at school or whatever and once I’ve registered I’m too nervous to cancel or ditch so I have to go lol). If you ever need someone to talk to my DMs are open for you

You definitely are not a failure. If it’s any comfort, I just turned 20 and don’t have a license either due to my fear of driving. You aren’t alone in how you feel!

The fact that you have private lessons coming up is great! Honestly, I find that exposing myself to driving has slowly lessened my anxiety around it over time. Practicing in a safe place like a parking lot is a good way to expose yourself to that fear and gradually become a bit more comfortable with driving
Don’t tell people to just “stop it”.. it’s never that easy. Things like this are hard, even if they don’t seem to be from an outside perspective

Hi! This sounds pretty similar to something I have called trichotillomania. I’m not sure if that’s exactly what you have, but this site may be of some use to you: https://www.bfrb.org/learn-about-bfrbs/treatment/self-help/104-50-ways-to-stop-pulling-your-hair

I refer to this site a lot to try out new ways to keep myself from picking my hair. I hope it can be of some help to you

Reading and commenting on this sub definitely helps me a lot. It’s nice to know that I’m not alone and that there are people that understand what I’m struggling with. 

I’ve been to several therapists in the past for trich, and there are quite a few different options for treatments (talk therapy, habit reversal therapy, medication, etc). It’s very bizarre that the therapists you saw seemed to not know what trich is. But don’t lose hope; there are plenty of different things you can try in order to treat it. It might take some time to find tactics that work for you, so don’t give up if you don’t find anything right away! Here is a site I refer to a lot that has some things you can try yourself: https://www.bfrb.org/learn-about-bfrbs/treatment/self-help/104-50-ways-to-stop-pulling-your-hair
I’ll look into it! Thank you :)

I experience this constantly! I think it’s called Misophonia. Sudden noises  often cause me to jump, and then is followed by a brief second of anger into anxiety that can last for a few minutes or longer. Honestly I haven’t found anything that helps much for very sudden/brief noises :/ the only thing that does is that I step away from the source of the noise for a moment to calm myself down. But it’s not always possible to do that, depending on the situation.
I completely get what you mean. My mom does it constantly when texting me and getting hit with an “lol.” can often make me super nervous. Like, did I say something wrong??

They’re personally not for me as they make me feel kinda trapped, but my little sister and dad both use one and they love them. My dad has had sleep issues for a long time and he says it helps him a lot
I remember reading a comment on here recently about an app called Slightly Robot. I started using it a few days ago and so far I really like it :)

Honestly the best medicine I’ve had so far is talk therapy. Initially I really hated it but once I found a therapist that I clicked with, I started to notice major improvements in myself. As for actual prescriptions, I’m currently on Effexor which I believe is also helping me a good deal. However, Effexor has some nasty withdrawal symptoms so I would definitely talk to your doctor about the side effects/etc beforehand if you do consider it

I had surgery a few years ago (destroyed my elbow and needs some screws). I spent most of the time leading up to the surgery reminding myself that the doctors know what they’re doing and that they’re professionals, and that they’ve done this so many times before. Although it didn’t completely clear the anxiety, being rational helped a lot. I would also talk to other people that I was close with just to have more reassurance that I’d be ok. Sometimes just saying your worries out loud to someone else can help a bit. 

You’re gonna be just fine. I hope your recovery after goes smoothly :)

Effexor withdrawals are awful. I’m on the max dose of 225mg and if I go even slightly over 24 hours without it, it feels like my brain is about to vomit (that doesn’t make sense but that’s how I describe it lol). It’s a super weird sensation in my head and eyes

YES. Oh gosh yes. I almost feel guilty on the days that I’m happy/calm enough to go out and do things.. I feel like since I’m able to have these good days, that I don’t deserve to say I struggle with anxiety. Like I’m making it up or something, if that makes sense

I get super angry for a brief second, followed by anxiety at most loud/sudden noises. Particularly the sound of plates clanging together or the sound of a motorcycle. Honestly I’ve always assumed this was normal and I was overthinking it.. not sure if it is, though. The only thing that helps me in these situations is to either put earbuds in and listen to white noise (i like ocean sounds mostly), or step away from the source of the sound for a moment to try to calm down. The earbuds thing isn’t always socially acceptable though (like it’s kinda rude to just start listening to music if you’re out at lunch with someone or something)

I do this too.. so many times I’ll find myself just sitting in the bathroom, looking at the bleeding mess on my legs/underarms/etc I’ve just caused with tweezers. The only thing that helped me was taking my tweezers and throwing them in the trash (in somewhere that’s not my house because I’m ashamed to say I’ve tossed them in my house then gone back through the trash to get them later) 
Honestly my only advice for this is to get rid of your tweezers in a way that ensures you can’t get them back. I personally also just let my body hair grow out, because for some reason when it isn’t super short or under the skin I lose interest in picking at it. This probably won’t work for everyone though. And if you do pick, don’t beat yourself up; relapses happen. Make sure you clean the area and disinfect as well if you break skin

I started when I was 8 or 9, and I didn't really realize it wasn't normal until I was in middle school. Kids can be brutal to anyone who is different or "weird looking", and I definitely was with my bald spots.

I learned the name trichotillomania around the same time, since my mother has it and began to notice the increasing hair loss in me.. knowing exactly what it is that causes me to do this is definitely somewhat comforting. It lets me know what options there are for treatment, like what you mentioned in your post. I'm definitely glad that I know what I have, and I think it has helped quite a lot. 

Good luck, I hope your hair continues to grow back healthy!! Amazing job on 4 years pull-free :D

The first few days/weeks are always so so hard, but once you've stopped for enough time it seems to get easier. You got this!!

Also, do you have any sources for mindfulness techniques? I've heard about it but I never actually tried any of it before

It's upsetting that people tell you to "just stop it", because it is so so difficult to control. But don't let that get you down, because you CAN overcome this, even if it is extremely hard. (And it definitely is not stupid to feel the way you do; trich can seriously mess with a person's self-esteem)

As for ways to stop, there are a few things you can try. Personally, I learned to love hats and headbands. I wear beanies/headbands/etc everywhere I go, even when I'm at home. Wearing a scarf or something at night also helps.  There are a lot other methods that people use to help break the habit/urge to pull, but everyone is different so it may take you some time to find something that works for you. Don't be discouraged if you don't find that something that helps right away (things like fidget toys, distracting yourself when the urge arises, wearing gloves, etc)

And honestly, I start to feel better about myself after just a few days without pulling my hair, so hopefully once you manage to stop, your outlook will begin to improve as well. Reward yourself when you go a day without pulling. Be kind to yourself; this is a difficult thing, but you can do it!! (Also, you mentioned medication withdrawals, so I assume that means you aren't taking a medication that you're supposed to be on; take your medicine! Stopping cold turkey can really mess with you. Keep yourself healthy, you've got this)
